name: 郁岑燁
oneLiner: 嘴上最挑剔、腰桿最直的劍修，對新人的第一句話就是質疑。

persona.identity: 天玄院第七室舍友，劍修
persona.appearance: 身形修長精實，背永遠挺直、動作很少。黑青短髮修剪整齊，額間一道細細的淡藍曜紋；窄臉、顴骨高、眼型細長，眉頭習慣性輕皺（推斷）。深藍黑色合身交領長袍配白色內領、窄袖，肩上一對細窄的深色漆皮護肩鑲金邊（推斷）；左腰佩一把黑漆鞘直劍，右手連指節纏著整齊的白布帶，像護指。
persona.temperament: 說話短、語氣平，不是故意嗆人，只是對不精確的判斷沒耐心。不主動靠近人，只在有話要糾正時抬眼。
persona.motivation: 把每件事做到標準——包括要求身邊的人也達到標準。
persona.arc: 嘴上挑剔新人、下手最先救人，第一章以標準訓練壓人卻不自覺暴露驕氣

image.prompt: A lean, tall young East Asian man around twenty, a sword cultivator of an ancient-Chinese-inspired mountain academy, standing very straight with squared shoulders and minimal movement, wearing a fitted cross-collar long robe of deep blue-black silk-cotton over a white inner collar, crisp narrow sleeves, slim dark lacquered leather shoulder pieces with thin gold edging, a narrow dark belt; a straight double-edged jian sword in a black lacquered scabbard at the left hip; the right hand and knuckles wrapped in neat white cloth bands like finger guards, the left hand bare. Narrow face with high cheekbones and a sharp jaw, long narrow dark eyes with a level, critical gaze, fine straight eyebrows drawn slightly together, thin lips pressed flat; short black hair with a deep blue sheen, neatly cut with a few precise strands framing the face; a thin luminous pale-blue meridian mark set vertically at the centre of the forehead. Smooth close-woven silk-cotton pressed flat and kept immaculate, the white cloth wrappings on the right hand clean and tightly wound. Three-quarter view, waist-up, plain neutral background. Soft directional key light from the upper left with a cool fill, gentle falloff, ambient occlusion under the chin and in the folds; shallow depth of field with the face in sharpest focus. deep blue-black and white palette with thin gold accents, cool morning light, ancient-Chinese-inspired cultivation academy, readable silhouette from every angle.
image.promptLocal: 一名約二十歲、修長高挑的東亞年輕男子，古代中國風格山岳學院的劍修，站得筆直、肩膀方正、動作極少。身穿深藍黑色絲棉合身交領長袍，內搭白色內領，俐落窄袖，細窄的深色漆皮護肩鑲細金邊，窄深色腰帶；左腰佩一把黑漆鞘雙刃直劍；右手連指節纏著整齊的白布帶像護指，左手裸露。窄臉、顴骨高、下頜線條銳利，細長的深色眼睛目光平直帶審視，細直的眉毛微微皺起，薄唇抿平；黑色短髮帶深藍光澤，修剪整齊，幾綹髮絲精準地垂在臉側；額頭正中一道縱向的細細淡藍色發光曜紋。平滑細密的絲棉布料燙得平整、一塵不染，右手白布纏得乾淨緊實。四分之三視角、半身、純中性背景。左上方柔和主光配冷調補光，光線自然衰減，下巴下方與衣褶有環境遮蔽；淺景深，面部最實。深藍黑與白色調配細金點綴、清冷晨光、古代中國風格修行學院，每個角度輪廓都清楚。

image.sheet: Single character model sheet on ONE 16:9 landscape canvas (widescreen, width to height exactly 16:9). The canvas is divided into three zones by thin hairline rules. LEFT ZONE — a vertical column occupying about 34% of the canvas width, separated from the rest by a thin vertical rule: one bust portrait, head and shoulders, front-facing, centred, framed like an ID photograph. BOTH SHOULDERS ARE FULLY VISIBLE with clear space on either side; do not crop the shoulders at the sides, and do not fade, vignette or round off the bottom edge — the portrait ends in a clean straight horizontal cut just below the chest. The figure wears a fitted deep blue-black cross-collar long robe over a white inner collar, with slim dark lacquered shoulder pieces edged in thin gold, with the face rendered in full detail: narrow face with high cheekbones and a sharp jaw, long narrow dark eyes with a level, critical gaze, fine straight eyebrows drawn slightly together, thin lips pressed flat; short black hair with a deep blue sheen, neatly cut with a few precise strands framing the face; a thin luminous pale-blue meridian mark set vertically at the centre of the forehead. LIGHTING IN THE LEFT ZONE ONLY: a soft directional key light from the upper left with gentle falloff, subtle ambient occlusion under the chin, in the eye sockets and where the collar meets the neck, giving the head real volume. RIGHT-TOP ZONE — the upper part of the remaining 66%, separated from the zone beneath it by a thin horizontal rule: three FULL-BODY views of the SAME character standing side by side — front view, left side profile, and back view — aligned on one shared ground line. PROPORTIONS ARE CRITICAL: all three figures share exactly the same height, head-to-body ratio and costume details; anatomy must be correct and natural — correct limb lengths, correct head size relative to the body, feet planted on the ground line; no stretching, squashing or foreshortening to make a figure fit the space. Each figure is drawn head to toe with clear margin above the head and below the feet. Neutral relaxed standing posture, arms at the sides. The figure is a lean, tall young East Asian man around twenty, a sword cultivator of an ancient-Chinese-inspired mountain academy, standing very straight with squared shoulders and minimal movement, wearing a fitted cross-collar long robe of deep blue-black silk-cotton over a white inner collar, crisp narrow sleeves, slim dark lacquered leather shoulder pieces with thin gold edging, a narrow dark belt; a straight double-edged jian sword in a black lacquered scabbard at the left hip; the right hand and knuckles wrapped in neat white cloth bands like finger guards, the left hand bare. Smooth close-woven silk-cotton pressed flat and kept immaculate, the white cloth wrappings on the right hand clean and tightly wound. The faces on all three full-body views are fully drawn and must match the bust portrait exactly — same features, same hairstyle, same expression. LIGHTING IN THE RIGHT ZONES: flat even orthographic lighting with no directional key and no cast shadows, so the figures stay measurable and cleanly cut out — only the left bust portrait is dramatically lit. RIGHT-BOTTOM ZONE — a detail strip beneath the three views, above which sits the thin horizontal rule: four to five small isolated close-up studies of the character's key details, evenly spaced in a row and clearly smaller than the full-body figures: the thin pale-blue meridian mark on the forehead; the right hand wrapped in white cloth bands over the knuckles; the straight jian's hilt and black lacquered scabbard; the crisp cross-collar with white inner collar; the gold-edged lacquered shoulder piece. If these details do not fit comfortably in one row along the bottom, continue them in a narrow vertical column down the right-hand edge of the canvas — but NEVER shrink or distort the three full-body figures to make room; the detail studies give way, not the figures. Plain pure white background (#FFFFFF) throughout, suitable for clean cut-out. Balanced composition with generous, even white margins; nothing crowded against an edge. deep blue-black and white palette with thin gold accents, cool morning light, ancient-Chinese-inspired cultivation academy, readable silhouette from every angle.
